source: Lesson 65 completed eligible passes and unchanged lesson 64 minutes in qualifying fullback-start fixtures.
rule: Count a completed eligible pass when end_x minus start_x is at least 20 on the StatsBomb 0–120 pitch-length coordinate scale, attacking towards x=120. Compare decimal coordinate values, including the exact threshold.
coordinate_policy: Both start and end must be finite in-pitch x,y pairs. Missing/invalid coordinates stop enrichment rather than becoming zero or silently dropping a completion.
metrics: Count; count per selected registered 90 minutes; count as a percentage of all eligible completed passes.
limitations: A transparent project definition, not a universal progressive-pass standard. It ignores lateral movement, defender lines, pressure, starting-zone opportunity and resulting chance value. A valuable short pass near goal may not qualify. Historical already inspected data; no new ability ranking or model fitting.
